name: Sentry Kite
presence: Sentry Kite wears three coats and a rifle older than the ash. She has the tired authority of someone who still believes in doors.

presenceWhen.text: Kite keeps the rifle low. "Don't make me learn your name," she says, which is her version of mercy.

greeting: "Clearance. One word. The radio on the walk knows it, if you know how to listen. I know how to shoot."

password.say: "I don't give the word to people who ask me for the word. That's the whole job. Listen to the tower. Or try your luck, briefly."

ash.say: "The thing in the mast uses faces. Don't give it yours for free. A lens helps. It also makes the radio speak in complete sentences."

relay.say: "East is the nest. You don't go east on charm."

say.say: Kite's rifle dips. "Clearance accepted." She looks tired of being correct. "The nest is east. Don't sell her anything she asks to borrow."
Kite doesn't blink. "That's a word, not a clearance. Come back when the tower has actually told you."

combat.onDeathSay: Kite goes down still trying to rack the old rifle. The roof is yours, and so is a small shame. East is unguarded.
